question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT lt.id_bioguide, lt.state, lt.term_start, l.gender
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
first_year_calc AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, state, gender, term_start,
           TRY_CAST(term_start AS DATE) AS first_start_date
    FROM first_terms
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        state,
        gender,
        first_start_date,
        first_start_date + INTERVAL '0 year' AS check_date,
        first_start_date + INTERVAL '2 year' AS check_date_2,
        first_start_date + INTERVAL '4 year' AS check_date_4,
        first_start_date + INTERVAL '6 year' AS check_date_6,
        first_start_date + INTERVAL '8 year' AS check_date_8,
        first_start_date + INTERVAL '10 year' AS check_date_10
    FROM first_year_calc
),
serving_status AS (
    SELECT 
        rc.id_bioguide,
        rc.state,
        rc.gender,
        rc.first_start_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= rc.check_date AND TRY_CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= rc.check_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained_0,
        MAX(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= rc.check_date_2 AND TRY_CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= rc.check_date_2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained_2,
        MAX(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= rc.check_date_4 AND TRY_CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= rc.check_date_4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained_4,
        MAX(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= rc.check_date_6 AND TRY_CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= rc.check_date_6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained_6,
        MAX(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= rc.check_date_8 AND TRY_CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= rc.check_date_8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained_8,
        MAX(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= rc.check_date_10 AND TRY_CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= rc.check_date_10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained_10
    FROM retention_check rc
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON lt.id_bioguide = rc.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY rc.id_bioguide, rc.state, rc.gender, rc.first_start_date
),
retention_by_state_gender AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        MAX(retained_0) AS has_retained_0,
        MAX(retained_2) AS has_retained_2,
        MAX(retained_4) AS has_retained_4,
        MAX(retained_6) AS has_retained_6,
        MAX(retained_8) AS has_retained_8,
        MAX(retained_10) AS has_retained_10
    FROM serving_status
    GROUP BY state, gender
)
